description: This file defines the ElseifBlock class, which extends the Block class and represents an 'elseif' conditional block within the SCSSPHP parser. It contains a constructor that sets the block type to T_ELSEIF.

classes.name: ElseifBlock
classes.description: Represents an 'elseif' conditional block in the SCSSPHP parser, extending the base Block class and setting its type appropriately.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ElseifBlock instance by setting its type to T_ELSEIF.
